name: Raúl Estévez
title: Software Developer
summary: Software developer with a strong academic background and hands-on experience in backend systems, cross-platform applications, privacy-first data tools, and artificial intelligence projects.

experience.description: Designed and developed a full-featured Flutter mobile app to extend the company ERP to smartphones. Implemented ~90% of the PHP/Laravel API layer from scratch. App covers authentication (configurable server URL, remember URL/user, auto session restore), clock-in/out with optional GPS, incident tracking, internal messaging with real-time polling, work orders with audio/image attachments and digital client signature, visit reports, client management (5 document types, Maps), holiday management, and role-based access control (6 profiles). Feature-based clean architecture with MVVM and SOLID, 3-layer error handling (15 error types), FlutterSecureStorage with Xiaomi/MIUI Keystore fallback, real-time server downtime detection, dark/light theme toggle, and two production variants via Flutter Flavors.
experience.demo_note: Independent reinterpretation with fictional data; contains no proprietary code or company information.

highlights: Technical capacity and problem-solving above average for an intern profile; rapid adaptation to languages and environments not previously studied
Fully satisfied with results; final product delivers real value to the organisation
Entrepreneurial attitude and excellent disposition for learning in new areas
recommendation.conclusion: Raúl Estévez is a professional ready for a real work environment and will be a great asset for any organisation that decides to incorporate him into their team.

projects.name: Mapper
projects.type: Web Data Mapping and Code Generation Tool
projects.description: Privacy-first browser tool for relating two data models such as classes, DTOs, JSON or schemas field by field. It suggests mappings that users can review and edit, then generates the code that converts one model into the other. Processing stays in the browser.

projects.name: DataCleanr
projects.type: Web and Desktop Data Cleaning Application
projects.description: Privacy-first application for cleaning, normalizing and deduplicating CSV, Excel, JSON and XML files. Processing stays on the user's device, proposed changes can be reviewed before applying them, and cleaned data can be exported without modifying or uploading the original file. Available on the web and as desktop releases for Windows, macOS and Linux.

projects.name: Api2Class
projects.type: Web and Desktop Code Generation Tool
projects.description: Privacy-first tool that turns JSON API responses into classes and typed models for Python, Java, TypeScript, C#, Kotlin, Dart, Swift, Go, PHP, Rust and Scala, plus JSON Schema and Smithy. An editable intermediate model shows optional, nullable and doubtful fields and lets users rename, retype or exclude them before generating. The JSON never leaves the user's device. Available on the web and as desktop releases for Windows, macOS and Linux, both producing the same code.

projects.name: Microvalencia ERP App
projects.description: Mobile application built in Flutter during an internship at Microvalencia Soluciones Informáticas. Integrated with the company ERP via custom Laravel/PHP REST APIs. projects.name: Cinema App
projects.description: Flutter movie discovery app consuming 9 REST endpoints from The Movie Database (TMDB) API through a dedicated datasource and mapper layer (MovieMapper, ActorMapper, GenreMapper) that converts API DTOs into domain entities. Built with Clean Architecture, Riverpod state management and Drift (SQLite) for local persistence of favorite movies. Features an autoplay slideshow, infinite-scroll movie lists, debounced search, genre-based browsing with per-genre pagination, and a custom app icon.
